status: frozen before extended crop, water or irrigation fetch; historical outcomes were already explored
holdout_status: reserved; no automatic validation until same-product complete rainfall and at least 10 held-out annual pairs exist

primary_validation.season: October previous year through September outcome year
primary_validation.model: yield ~ intercept + year + rain; coefficient fitted through 2023, evaluate predictive improvement against year-only baseline on future years; no refit/lag search

exploratory_original_family.multiplicity: BH separately on partial-time, HAC and block-permutation p values; overlapping samples limit arbitrary-dependence guarantees

wheat_followup_family.additional_tests: three total-rain by post-1990 interaction tests, one per outcome
wheat_followup_family.multiplicity: BH over all 30 HAC p values including unavailable tests as p=1

irrigation: Use explicitly reported values only; no interpolation, annual carry-forward or claims that year proxy identifies irrigation effect. Report availability before fitting; sparse/estimated coverage requires separate sensitivity design.
season_definition: Former rain = October-November; latter rain = March-April. Proxy windows fixed before extensions; national gridded rain is not crop-region rainfall.
theme: Deuteronomy 11:14 / Deuteronomy 8:8; interpretive metadata, no measured fulfillment claim
